instruction: Songs of which genre have I liked the least in my Spotify album library?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only information gathering. Aggregation (counting liked songs per genre and taking the minimum) cannot be expressed in STRIPS, so the library albums, their songs and the answer genre are modeled by representative placeholder objects (library-album, library-album-song, least-liked-genre). The knowledge chain is: show_album_library reveals album ids, show_album reveals song ids, show_liked_songs reveals which songs are liked, and show_song reveals each song's genre; once all are known the agent computes the least-liked genre, modeled as the effect (found-least-liked-genre ?g) of the final show_song lookup. supervisor-complete-task passes the genre as the answer and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) preconditions. In practice the agent iterates show_album/show_song over all albums/songs and paginates the list APIs.
